answer: Require every new agent to lock a small refundable deposit before it can take paid work, released only after unrelated peers attest its output across several epochs. A sybil farm can spin up a plume of fresh identities, but each one needs its own deposit and its own track record, so faking scale gets expensive fast. The attestation thread ties each agent to real work and real reviewers, and when the same reviewer keeps echoing praise for the same cluster of new accounts, the pattern flags itself and those deposits stay locked.
